programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: LITTLE TRAIN TITIPO, NEWBORN IN CHOO CHOO TOWN, JUST PASSED HIS DRIVING EXAM AND IS READY TO WORK IN THE RAILWAY VILLAGE. ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: Two mice, Shuke and Beta, become partners and embark on amazing adventures. They help other animals with their helicopter and tank, gaining love and friendship along the way.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer is a variety show that provides entertainment and education. Abang l will invite viewers to play and learn things that are appropriate for his age, with different topics in each episode. Abang L's funny antics, charm, and energy will bring this program to life. The articulate Abang L will ask questions to people around him. He will also try out several professions with the aim of educating viewers about each role.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 27 HORIZON SEASON 2
programme.desc: LIKO, ROY, AND DOT JOIN NARANJA ACADEMY FOR TERA TRAINING, WHERE THEY MUST FACE VARIOUS GYM LEADERS. DURING THEIR JOURNEY, THEY MEET OLD FRIENDS, MAKE NEW RIVALS, AND FACE THE THREAT OF A GROUP OF EXPLORERS WHO ARE AFTER THE SECRETS OF TERAPAGOS. AS THEY HON THEIR TERASTALS, THEY MUST ALSO FACE THE CHALLENGES OF THE TOURNAMENT AND SUDDEN ATTACKS FROM THE ENEMY.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: POCOYO
programme.desc: POCOYO IS AN ANIMATED SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF AN ENERGY AND CURIOUS LITTLE BOY NAMED POCOYO. WITH HIS FRIENDS, PATO (DUCK), ELLY (ELEPHANT), LOULA (DOG), AND SLEEPY BIRD (BIRD), POCOYO EXPLORE HIS COLORFUL WORLD WITH BOUNDLESS JOY AND CURIOSITY. EACH EPISODE FEATURES A NEW ADVENTURE WHERE POCOYO LEARNS ABOUT FRIENDSHIP, HONESTY, AND OVERCOMES CHALLENGES WITH HIS IMAGINATION AND INTELLIGENCE. With the help of his friends and guidance from PANDAI (the unseen voice actor), Pocoyo encounters hilarious and engaging situations that bring positive and educational messages to young viewers. With its bright and cheerful animation style, "Pocoyo" is a series that entertains while teaching children important values ​​about cooperation, kindness, and exploring the world around them.

programme.title: SHIMAJIRO 2D
programme.desc: SHIMAJIRO 2D ANIMATION IS A CHARACTER FOR PRESCHOOL CHILDREN, WHICH COMBINES THE POWER OF ENTERTAINMENT WITH THE BENEFITS OF EARLY DEVELOPMENT TO GIVE YOU AND YOUR CHILD AN INNOVATIVE LEARNING EXPERIENCE. SHIMAJIRO WILL ENTERTAIN AND EDUCATE YOUR CHILD WITH NURSING SONGS THAT WE SING TOGETHER AND HELP THEM LEARN THE SKILLS THEY NEED FOR THE FUTURE!.

programme.title: GO JETTER
programme.desc: GO JETTERS IS AN ANIMATED ADVENTURE AND EDUCATIONAL SERIES THAT FOLLOWS FOUR YOUNG SUPERHEROES, XULI, KYAN, LARS, AND FOZ, LEAD BY THEIR UNIQUE DISCO MENTOR, UBERCORN.

programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: LITTLE TRAIN TITIPO, NEWBORN IN CHOO CHOO TOWN, JUST PASSED HIS DRIVING EXAM AND IS READY TO WORK IN THE RAILWAY VILLAGE. ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: Two mice, Shuke and Beta, become partners and embark on amazing adventures. They help other animals with their helicopter and tank, gaining love and friendship along the way.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer is a variety show that provides entertainment and education. Abang l will invite viewers to play and learn things that are appropriate for his age, with different topics in each episode. Abang L's funny antics, charm, and energy will bring this program to life. The articulate Abang L will ask questions to people around him. He will also try out several professions with the aim of educating viewers about each role.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA SPESIAL LIBURAN CERIA (PORORO & FRIENDS: VIRUS BUSTERS)
programme.desc: DANGER STRIKES! WHEN A MYSTERIOUS COMPUTER VIRUS BEGINS TO ATTACK AND DISRUPT THE CITY, Pororo AND HIS FRIENDS MUST TRANSFORM INTO THE “VIRUS BUSTERS” TEAM. WITH ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY, THEY ARE READY TO ELIMINATE THE EVIL VIRUS MONSTERS!

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 27 HORIZON SEASON 2
programme.desc: LIKO, ROY, AND DOT JOIN NARANJA ACADEMY FOR TERA TRAINING, WHERE THEY MUST FACE VARIOUS GYM LEADERS. DURING THEIR JOURNEY, THEY MEET OLD FRIENDS, MAKE NEW RIVALS, AND FACE THE THREAT OF A GROUP OF EXPLORERS WHO ARE AFTER THE SECRETS OF TERAPAGOS. AS THEY HON THEIR TERASTALS, THEY MUST ALSO FACE THE CHALLENGES OF THE TOURNAMENT AND SUDDEN ATTACKS FROM THE ENEMY.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.desc: Follow a group of children who are evacuated to a Yorkshire village during the Second World War, where they encounter a young soldier who, like them, is far away from home.

programme.desc: A seventeen-year-old navigates his survival amongst an explosive criminal family and the detective who thinks he can save him.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Badge Of Honor
programme.desc: When a drug raid ends in tragedy, veteran detectives find themselves under relentless scrutiny as an Internal Affairs investigator searches for the truth behind the fatal shooting. As hidden evidence, corruption, and conflicting loyalties begin to surface, every decision threatens to destroy careers and lives. Badge of Honor is a gritty crime thriller that explores justice, accountability, and the blurred line between duty and personal conscience.

programme.title: Anything Is Possible
programme.desc: Kelsa, a bright and self-assured transgender high school senior, has learned to navigate life on her own terms despite the challenges around her. When a shy classmate develops feelings for her, the two embark on a heartfelt journey of first love, self-discovery, and acceptance. As they face family expectations, friendships, and the pressures of adolescence, they discover that honesty, courage, and compassion can overcome fear and prejudice. Anything Is Possible is an uplifting coming-of-age romance that celebrates authenticity and the power of being true to yourself.

programme.title: East Of The Mountains

programme.title: The Silencing
programme.desc: A reformed hunter living in isolation on a wildlife sanctuary becomes involved in a deadly game of cat and mouse when he and the local Sheriff set out to track a vicious killer who may have kidnapped his daughter years ago.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers comprehensive coverage of the entertainment world through the latest celebrity news, exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes features, and updates on movies, television, music, and lifestyle. The program also highlights upcoming events, industry trends, and inspiring stories from artists and entertainers, providing viewers with a complete overview of the entertainment scene.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World is a news magazine program that delivers in-depth reports on international affairs, global trends, and human-interest stories. Covering topics such as politics, business, technology, culture, and social issues, the program highlights how events around the world influence people's lives while presenting unique Taiwanese perspectives on international developments.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player follows Pun, who returns to Thailand after her fiancé disappears with her savings. Determined to find him, she approaches Ploy, a successful actress and the fugitive's sister, hoping to uncover his whereabouts. As their relationship grows more complicated, secrets, deception, and unexpected romance emerge, forcing both women to confront the truth while navigating danger, betrayal, and their evolving feelings for one another.

programme.title: Father's Wish
programme.desc: Father's Wish tells the emotional story of a father's unwavering love and sacrifice for his family. As unexpected hardships threaten their future, he remains determined to fulfill an important promise that will secure a better life for his loved ones. Through moments of joy, heartbreak, and resilience, the film explores the enduring bond between parent and child, highlighting the strength of family, hope, and unconditional love.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey takes viewers on a flavorful exploration of diverse culinary traditions across different regions. Each episode highlights local ingredients, time-honored recipes, and the stories of chefs, home cooks, and artisans who preserve their communities' food heritage. Combining travel, history, and gastronomy, the series celebrates how food reflects culture, identity, and everyday life.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
